title: Three metadata defects: gallery images, title suffixes, missing-title fallback
acceptance:
An inside a stray
  • is captured as an image block; commons_gallery yields its 28 real photos rather than filename captions alone
A <title> of the form "Article - Section - Site" is trimmed to the article title even when the site name is not the final separator segment; gnu_philosophy no longer keeps the full tag
A page with no <html>, <head>, <title> or <h1> derives a better title than the request host; rfc_editor_2616 is the case
Each of the three gains a frozen expectation, replacing its finding in Fixtures/README.md
notes:
Three separate metadata-only defects from T-0006's findings; content extraction is correct in all three. (1) BlockBuilder's li case and appendList never look inside a stray
  • for an . (2) trimmingSiteSuffix only checks the last separator segment, so gnu.org's 'Article - Section - Free Software Foundation' never matches the host. (3) rfc_editor_2616's capture has no html/head/title/h1 at all — its heading is a styled span — so title falls back to the host.
